data.overview: Having survived one murderous family tradition, Grace discovers the contest has only widened. Her estranged sister is dragged into a battle among rival dynasties for the council's supreme chair, where escape and control of the world share the same prize.
data.tagline: Round two is a family affair.
data.title: Bride of the High Seat
